notes: Fixed explosion animation flicker at non-default blast thresholds by trusting the engine result instead of re-simulating it in the UI, removed the 6-level threshold which looked identical to 5 on the board, game config changes now apply immediately without saving first, and fixed the web build page structure and a caching issue that broke styling
notes_zh: 修复非 4 级阈值下爆炸动画闪回（引擎结果不再被前端重复判一遍）、移除视觉上无法区分的 6 级阈值、游戏配置改动立即生效无需先保存；优化评分图表标题与最具价值一步的显示，修复网页版页面结构与缓存导致的样式失效
